scenes.title: Hook: what, where, when
scenes.purpose: [hook-event] What, where, when, with the hero already on screen.
scenes.why: States what happened, where and when.
on_screen_text: Fire at a government data center
scenes.visual: Tile grid on screen from frame 0; headline; stamp; origin ring pulses on one tile; source chip.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: One continuous surface; the camera and the object's state carry the change.

scenes.title: Scale: 647 systems
scenes.purpose: [scale] How big: a one-tile-one-system grid changes state.
scenes.why: Gives the scale: how many systems stopped.
scenes.visual: Counter to 647; tiles go dark in a ripple from the origin; 96 nearest turn red; confirmed chip.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: One continuous surface; the camera and the object's state carry the change.

scenes.title: Unknowns: the cause
scenes.purpose: [unknowns] What is not confirmed is drawn differently: dashed and grey.
scenes.visual: Dashed ring draws round the burned tiles and marches; reported chip solid; investigation chip dashed; burned tiles pulse.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: One continuous surface; the camera and the object's state carry the change.

scenes.title: Response: dated recovery
scenes.purpose: [response] The same tiles come back, step by dated step.
scenes.visual: Tiles turn green in three dated steps: 17.3%, 89.0%, 98.2%.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.

transition_out.continuity: One continuous surface; the camera and the object's state carry the change.

scenes.title: What next and sources
scenes.purpose: [source-close] The open item and the sources; the grid still moves.
scenes.why: Closes on what was lost and where it comes from.
scenes.visual: Unrestored tiles pulse; the G-Drive fact with a dashed chip; sources with the as-of date.

layout.portrait: Copy in the top band, hero in the middle, captions above the bottom UI zone.
